summary.text: CBPAUP0C is a batch IMS DL/I program (PSB name PSBPAUTB in working storage, PCB number 2) that purges expired pending authorizations from the pending-authorization IMS database. It reads a SYSIN parameter card (expiry days, checkpoint frequency, checkpoint display frequency, debug flag) and applies defaults when values are missing. It walks every PAUTSUM0 summary root segment with GN and, for each, every PAUTDTL1 child detail with GNP; a detail whose age in days (current YYDDD minus the un-complemented authorization date) reaches the expiry threshold is deleted with DLET and its amount/count is backed out of the in-memory summary counters. After the children are processed, the summary is deleted when its approved count is zero or less. IMS checkpoints (CHKP with id 'RMAD'+counter) are taken every P-CHKP-FREQ summaries and at end of run; read/delete totals are displayed and any unexpected DL/I status ends the run with RETURN-CODE 16.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Initializes, reads the first summary, then loops until ERR-FLG-ON or END-OF-AUTHDB: reads child details and for each one runs the expiry check and deletes it if QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE. After the details, deletes the summary when PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 (the condition repeats the same field twice), takes a checkpoint when WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT exceeds P-CHKP-FREQ and resets the counter, then reads the next summary. Takes a final checkpoint, displays the four read/delete totals and GOBACKs.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.logic: Accepts CURRENT-DATE (YYMMDD) and CURRENT-YYDDD from the system date and PRM-INFO from SYSIN, and displays them. Defaults WS-EXPIRY-DAYS to 5 when P-EXPIRY-DAYS is not numeric, P-CHKP-FREQ to 5 and P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ to 10 when spaces/zero/low-values, and forces P-DEBUG-FLAG to 'N' unless it is 'Y'.

paragraphs.name: 2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.logic: Issues DL/I GN for the next PAUTSUM0 root into PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY. On status spaces it counts the read (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ, WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) and saves PA-ACCT-ID in WS-CURR-APP-ID; on 'GB' sets END-OF-AUTHDB; any other status displays the error and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL
paragraphs.logic: Issues DL/I GNP for the next PAUTDTL1 child of the current summary into PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS. Status spaces sets MORE-AUTHS and counts WS-NO-DTL-READ; 'GE' or 'GB' sets NO-MORE-AUTHS; any other status displays the error with PA-ACCT-ID and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED
paragraphs.logic: Recovers the authorization date as 99999 - PA-AUTH-DATE-9C and computes WS-DAY-DIFF = CURRENT-YYDDD - WS-AUTH-DATE. If WS-DAY-DIFF >= WS-EXPIRY-DAYS the detail is QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE and the summary counters are backed out: response '00' decrements PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT and subtracts PA-APPROVED-AMT from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT, otherwise decrements PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT and subtracts PA-TRANSACTION-AMT from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT; else NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE.

paragraphs.name: 5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL
paragraphs.logic: Issues DL/I DLET of the current PAUTDTL1 segment from PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS. Status spaces adds 1 to WS-NO-DTL-DELETED; otherwise displays the failure with PA-ACCT-ID and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.logic: Issues DL/I DLET of the current PAUTSUM0 root segment from PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY. Status spaces adds 1 to WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED; otherwise displays the failure with PA-ACCT-ID and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT
paragraphs.logic: Issues DL/I CHKP with ID WK-CHKPT-ID ('RMAD' + WK-CHKPT-ID-CTR). On success adds 1 to WS-NO-CHKP and, once it reaches P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ, resets it and displays the summary count and current account id; on failure displays DIBSTAT and counts and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND
paragraphs.logic: Displays 'CBPAUP0C ABENDING ...', sets RETURN-CODE to 16 and GOBACKs (no real ABEND or rollback call is issued).

paragraphs.name: 9999-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9999-ABEND (EXIT only, never reached because 9999-ABEND ends with GOBACK).

rules.statement: A pending authorization detail is selected for purge when the number of days between today (YYDDD) and its authorization date (99999 minus the stored complemented PA-AUTH-DATE-9C) is greater than or equal to the expiry-days threshold.
rules.outcome: QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE set; MAIN-PARA then deletes the PAUTDTL1 segment (5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL). Otherwise NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE and the detail is kept.

rules.statement: When an expired detail is purged, its effect is backed out of the summary totals: an approved detail (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE '00') decrements PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT and reduces PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT by PA-APPROVED-AMT; any other response code decrements PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT and reduces PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT by PA-TRANSACTION-AMT.
rules.conditions: Detail qualified for delete; split on PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00'
rules.outcome: Summary counters in PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY are reduced in working storage (no REPL of the summary segment is issued in this program).

rules.statement: After all details of an account summary have been processed, the pending authorization summary root is deleted when its approved authorization count is zero or negative. The condition tests PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT twice; the declined count is not tested.
rules.outcome: 6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY performs DLET of the PAUTSUM0 segment (IMS deletes any remaining child details with it).

rules.statement: Run parameters default when missing: expiry days default to 5 when the SYSIN value is not numeric; checkpoint frequency defaults to 5 and checkpoint display frequency to 10 when blank, zero or low-values; the debug flag is forced to 'N' unless it is 'Y'.
rules.conditions: SYSIN PRM-INFO fields absent or invalid
rules.outcome: WS-EXPIRY-DAYS = 5, P-CHKP-FREQ = 5, P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ = 10, P-DEBUG-FLAG = 'N' as applicable.

rules.statement: An IMS checkpoint is taken after more than P-CHKP-FREQ summaries have been processed since the last checkpoint, and again at the end of the run, so the purge is committed in units of work.
rules.outcome: 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT issues DLI CHKP and WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT is reset to 0.

rules.statement: Any DL/I status other than the expected ones (spaces; 'GB' end of database on summary read; 'GE'/'GB' on detail read) on read, delete or checkpoint stops the purge with return code 16 after displaying the status and counters.
rules.conditions: Unexpected DIBSTAT after GN, GNP, DLET or CHKP

existing_rules_reviewed.note: Matches code; default of 5 at 196-199. Same as BR-CBPAUP0C-001/004. Note the YYDDD subtraction does not handle year boundaries.
Matches code. The reductions are in working storage only; the summary segment is never replaced (no REPL), so they only influence the summary-delete decision. Same as BR-CBPAUP0C-002.

no_rule_decisions.reason: Loop control over child details and invocation of delete based on the flag set by BR-CBPAUP0C-001.
Controls how often a checkpoint-success progress message is displayed; operational logging only.

observations.text: Summary-delete condition repeats PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT on both sides of AND; the declined count is never tested, so summaries with only remaining declined details (or untouched approved count of 0) are deleted together with their children.
Summary counters/amounts are reduced in working storage but the PAUTSUM0 segment is never updated with REPL; surviving summaries keep stale totals in the database.

Day difference is CURRENT-YYDDD minus a YYDDD date; across a year boundary the difference is about 1000 minus days, and if the auth date is later than today (negative diff) it is never expired. Julian arithmetic is not calendar-aware.
WK-CHKPT-ID-CTR is never incremented, so every checkpoint uses the same ID 'RMAD0000'.

P-CHKP-FREQ and P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ are PIC X(05) compared to numeric counters and initialized with numeric MOVEs (5, 10) into alphanumeric fields; comparisons are alphanumeric and depend on left-justified/zero-padded SYSIN values.
ERR-FLG-ON is tested in the main loop but never set; WS-INFILE-STATUS, WS-CUSTID-STATUS, CURRENT-DATE, WS-TOT-REC-WRITTEN, IDX and the IMS-RETURN-CODE 88-levels are unused.
9999-ABEND only sets RETURN-CODE 16 and GOBACKs; no ROLB/abend is issued, so updates since the last checkpoint are committed at normal program termination (IMS behaviour) rather than backed out.

sme_questions.question: Was the summary delete intended to require both PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 AND PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT <= 0?
Should the reduced summary totals be written back (REPL) for summaries that are not deleted?
How should expiry be computed across year boundaries (YYDDD arithmetic)?
